context.question: For every bipartite pure state of qubits, does the sorted computational-basis Schmidt representative minimize the stabilizer 2-Rényi entropy over independent local unitaries?
context.locator: Sierant, Conjecture 1, equations 3–6. Open Quantum Problems E27.
context.experiment: Prove the missing overlap inequalities for seven-dimensional supports and validate the exact certificate.
context.known: Sierant proves the dyadic-staircase and rank-at-most-six cases. Our working paper gives a scoped rank-seven result for external review.
context.scope: Arbitrary rank and local register sizes are required for the full conjecture. A strictly lower entropy for a state on the same local-unitary orbit would refute it.
